name: Kruger NP plot-scale (EBP) and landscape fire database with grass fuel moisture (Ongole et al. 2026 topkill model data)
access_method: Zenodo REST API record 23915836, files/data.zip + scripts.zip (no login)
date_range: not given in source (fire season WET/DRY only; no year)
citation: Ongole S, Midzi T, Govender N, Smit I, Kruger L, Higgins S (2026) Data from: Calibrating a fire intensity model to predict topkill risk for trees in an African savanna. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.23915835
notes: 1,660 source rows -> 1,586 PFE fires (one row each) + 3 distinct moisture samples for the 74-plot landscape fire (aggregated_mean). m is wet-basis fraction (inferred from authors' JAGS model 3015*m+Qv*(1-m)) converted to % dry weight; mixed green/cured sward -> live grass, mixed_curing. No dates/coords: geocoded to landscape centroid of 4 EBP strings (precision 15 km, location_approx). Fuel load, intensity, ROS, ERA5-Land VPD/wind in covariates. Overlap with Cardoso 2022 not checkable (Dryad blocked).
